# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 1,809 AI agent tools in 30 categories, including 252 MCP servers (252 of 252 MCP servers responded today (verified Oct 27, 2026)). Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse). AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-10-27 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 252 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $29, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Key pages

- [MCP server pricing table](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/pricing.html): every MCP server's stated pricing, dated, with change history
- [MCP server link status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/link-status.html): latest automated link check for every MCP server, with change history
- [AgentScout MCP server](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/connect.html): free, read-only MCP endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key; also at https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse) with search_tools, get_tool, list_categories, best_for_task and list_packages. Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance
- [MCP servers category](https://agentscouthq.com/categories/mcp-servers.html): 252 tools
- [New tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- [AI agent news](https://agentscouthq.com/news/): daily AI agent and MCP news stories with sources
- [Free AI agent tools](https://agentscouthq.com/free-tools.html): AgentScout's free calculators and builders plus free and open-source tools from the directory
- [Free AI image generator](https://agentscouthq.com/generate.html): no sign-up image generator

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28): 13

- [The Drive AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/the-drive-ai.html) (added 2026-10-27): AI file workspace with an agent signup flow: any agent can create its own The Drive AI account with one CLI command, save and organize files through an MCP server, then hand the workspace to a person via a claim link.
- [Cardboard](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cardboard.html) (added 2026-10-27): AI video editor for the browser and Mac that builds an editable first cut from a prompt and your footage, then lets you refine by chat or timeline; also edits video inside ChatGPT and Claude through its MCP plugin.
- [Daiku](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/daiku.html) (added 2026-10-27): Add-on that gives Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and other AI apps their own cloud Chrome logged in to your sites, working in many tabs at once while your laptop is shut, with every send or payment approved on your phone.
- [Haymon Database MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/haymon-database-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-27): Single-binary open source MCP server that connects Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite, with built-in PII redaction and write prevention.
- [Marrow AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/marrow-ai.html) (added 2026-10-27): Control layer for AI agents that checks policy, risk and prior outcomes before an agent acts, can require a named human yes, and keeps proof and outcome history; works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and MCP.
- [Midplane](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/midplane.html) (added 2026-10-27): YC-backed MCP gateway between AI assistants and Postgres that checks every SQL statement against your policy, blocks unfiltered writes, masks sensitive fields, asks for human approval and logs everything inside your network.
- [Atlaso](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/atlaso.html) (added 2026-10-27): AI memory layer that captures your decisions, preferences and projects once and recalls them across Claude Code and other connected AI tools via plugin and hosted MCP, with personal and project memory.
- [Bowmark](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/bowmark.html) (added 2026-10-27): Turns websites into typed functions agents can call over an HTTP API, MCP server or Claude/Codex plugin, so they can read prices, availability and listings or take actions on live sites without driving a browser.
- [Scrawl](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/scrawl.html) (added 2026-10-27): Mac app that lets you show a coding agent a problem: press a hotkey, talk, click and draw over your screen or a mirrored iPhone, and Scrawl turns it into transcribed, cropped frames you paste into your agent.
- [Zoetrope](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/zoetrope.html) (added 2026-10-27): Free, local viewer that turns Claude Code and Codex session transcripts into a live flow graph of every agent and subagent, with tool-call pass/fail status, time-travel replay and full prompt provenance, in the terminal or browser.
- [MangaTranslate](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mangatranslate.html) (added 2026-10-27): AI manga, manhwa, comic, and PDF image translator by Ficory LLC featuring multi-language OCR text recognition across 100+ languages, automatic original text removal, background inpainting, smart typesetting, batch image processing, and interactive dialogue review.
- [Miqayel AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/miqayel-ai.html) (added 2026-10-27): AI workspace for live web research, image creation and editing, and code generation with an interactive live Canvas preview, file analysis, computer use, and connected app automations in one interface.
- [Desearch](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/desearch.html) (added 2026-10-27): Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server (https://mcp.desearch.ai/mcp) and open-source adapter (MIT) giving Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and AI agents citable AI search, live web search, full-page extraction, and X (Twitter) post and profile search with your Desearch API key.

## Community Grok Bot templates

- [PR Reviewer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pr-reviewer): Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and thin context so review starts with the scary diff. Leads with what can break, what is untested.
- [Agent Looper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-agent-looper): You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
- [Examiner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-examiner): Maintain a reliable timeline of important changes so you can reconstruct what happened when something later goes wrong. Isolated: talk only to you.
- [AI Harness Assistant](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-harness-assistant): Keeps the AI coding tools you already have, like Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Cursor, current on your Windows, Mac, and Linux machines.
- [GreenBuild](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-greenbuild): A senior QA and test-automation lead for testers and dev teams. It turns requirements into test plans and triages flaky tests.
- [UI/UX/Designer. Product Engineer 1000x](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-1000x-product-engineer): World-class product engineer for mobile and desktop web. Ships Convex + TanStack + React end to end. Simple, intuitive UI with real taste.
- [illo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-illo): Editorial illustration bot that uses the illo skill (tmchow/illo-skill) to turn ideas, posts, and announcements into mascot-led images on Grok Bot.
- [Design Expert](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-design-expert): A product design lead that keeps AI-built UIs honest.
- [Fabrication](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-fabrication): Takes your parts from CAD design to a finished 3D print. It checks fit, flat bed faces and hole sizes, and shows previews.
- [Churn retention manager](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-churn-retention-manager): Catches churn before it lands, offers a real alternative, and reports why people left. For businesses saving cancellations and failed payments.
- [Echo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-echo): Turns a customer call into slides from customer context. What we heard, next steps, project initiatives, or all of the above.
- [Events](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-events): A market and pop-up inventory desk for small sellers. It builds pack lists before a show and logs what sold afterward.
- [Go Direct](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-go-direct): Skip the press. Lulu helps founders tell their story straight to the 50 to 500 people who actually matter: investors, early customers, future hires.
- [LinkedIn Desk](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-linkedin-desk): LinkedIn Desk helps you keep network quality high without living in LinkedIn, by reviewing connection requests and LinkedIn invitations.
- [Meeting to Money](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-sumosign): Turns a sales meeting into a priced proposal, a signed go-ahead, an invoice, and payment chase. You approve every send. For freelancers and small agencies.
- [DOGE (Department of Grok Efficiency)](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-chief-of-staff-avid): A Grok Bot whose only job is to audit your other bots and routines, flag what to cut or merge, and find bottlenecks.
- [Watchdog](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-watchdog): On first install, scans email once as soon as Gmail is ready, then weekly for receipts, renewals, and trials.
- [AIUsageBot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-usage-meter): Interviews you about which AI subscriptions to track and where leftover lives (local CLIs, apps), then pings remaining % as it drops.
- [SlowBooks Cutover](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-slowbooks-cutover): Migrate one QuickBooks Desktop company into SlowBooks via Conductor (read-only), then prove Trial Balance and spot-check P&L.
- [Newsletter Cleanup](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-newsletter-cleanup): Audits Gmail newsletters (last 6 months), builds a three-bucket review.html, then unsubscribes only what you approve. Never deletes mail.
- [Bot inbox](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-bot-inbox): A weekday unread digest for Grok Bots. Lists bots and group chats with new activity, one line each. Type scan anytime.
- [Dewey](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-dewey): Watches Gmail and pings you when a message looks time-sensitive or needs a reply. Reads freely; never sends, replies, or trashes mail unless you ask.
- [Harper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-harper): An executive assistant for email, calendar, and texting. It triages your inbox, schedules people, protects deep-work time.
- [Backpack](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-backpack): Reads school and activity emails you don't have time for and turns them into calendar events, reminders, and a weekly family plan.
- [BFCM Email Planner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-bfcm-email-planner): Plans your full Black Friday / Cyber Monday email and SMS calendar: sends, segments, offer angles, subject lines.
- [Be Happier](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-be-happier): Looks at your email and calendar each week, then suggests 3 concrete things that would make you happier. Protects existing life, does not add new habits.
- [Chef](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-chef): A home-cooking helper that adapts to the country you live in: seasonal produce, local dishes, holidays, and grocers where you are.
- [Interview Prep](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-interview-prep): Interview prep for any topic. Pick the topic and level, then climb with examples, running code, and quizzes until it feels interview-ready.
- [Canvas](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-canvas): Keeps an eye on a student's Canvas LMS: daily reminders of what's due, overdue or missing, assignment briefs and rubrics, and pass-mark math.
- [EG4 Monitor](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-eg4-monitor): Watches your EG4 solar and battery system on EG4 Monitor Center and sends you a nightly report with estimated savings, all read-only.
- [Human Copywriter](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-human-copywriter): A human-voice rewrite desk for email, posts, blogs, DMs, landing-page bodies, and PR. American English by default.
- [Index](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-index-seo-aeo-teammate): An SEO and AEO program teammate. On first run it reads what you already connected, recommends a stack, and only asks for gaps.
- [RedReplier](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-redreplier): Watches Reddit, X, Hacker News and Bluesky for mentions of your product, competitors and buying-signal phrases.
- [Scout](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-scout-competitive-intelligence): A competitive intelligence agent for organic growth that watches rival sites, search rankings, and AI-answer visibility so real moves don’t get buried.
- [socials](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-socials-short-form-scout): Content scout for short-form creators: watches X and YouTube for filmable AI and tech stories and sends short, ready-to-film kits in chat.
- [AI Resource Sift](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-resource-sift): For one AI topic, sweep papers, code, lectures, courses, Reddit, and official lab docs, then keep a large filtered stack.
- [Research Bot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-research-bot): This bot exists to do deep research and provide verifiable answers with sources.
- [Thoth](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-thoth-researcher-archivist): Named for the Egyptian god of writing, knowledge, and the moon. He does deep research for whatever you are working on.
- [2nd Brain](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-2nd-brain): Compiles notes, PDFs, and X bookmarks into an inspectable markdown wiki (Karpathy Lattice: raw/ → wiki/).
- [AI Radar](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-radar): Always-on AI news radar. Watches AI labs' official X accounts, their staff, researchers and well-known people, plus blogs and changelogs.
- [StoriesBot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-storiesbot): Search 17 years of MacStories.net. Longform reviews, Setups, the Shortcuts Archive, and anything Federico or John published. Filter by time and author.
- [Frontier Model Watch](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-frontier-model-watch): Watches official releases from xAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Moonshot, Alibaba, Zhipu, DeepSeek, MiniMax, and Tencent. Runs at 07:30 EAT.
- [Revenue Signal Radar](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-revenue-signal-radar): Weekday revenue-action radar for HubSpot shops. Ranks expansion, stalled deals, and closed-lost revival with evidence and draft next steps.
- [X Algo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-x-algo): Helps X posters decide when to quote, ship a new post, or wait. Reads the public For You ranking code and live post metrics.
- [AEO Content Producer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-aeo-content-producer): Produces AEO refreshes and net-new articles from AI visibility data: briefs, drafts, and an editorial pass — then stops for your review.
- [Gong Call Coach](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-gong-call-coach): Reviews Gong call recordings and gives short, actionable coaching after the fact.
- [Exec CoS Digest](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-exec-cos-digest): Weekday chief-of-staff bot: morning calendar digest plus night-before external meeting prep. Drafts only — you approve anything irreversible.
- [Engineer's Morning Brief](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-engineer-s-morning-brief): Before standup each day, one short brief covering today's meetings, the PRs waiting on you, failing CI, and the messages that actually need you.
- [Time Keeper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-time-keeper): A calendar assistant that sends a morning digest (one good quote, then the day) and a next-day briefing every night.
- [Babel - live translator](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-babel-live-translator): Live Zoom translator. Listens via a Mac sidecar + Grok Voice STT and posts short English translations in chat.
- [Forge](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-forge-template-foundry): One keyword in, a production-ready Grok Bot recipe out.
- [loops](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-loops): An engineering outer loop that sits above your coding agents.
- [Grimoire](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-grimoire-s-tome-the-grim-council): A 50-skill coding wizard with a 20-member advisory council.
- [Apps](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-apps): Describe an app in one sentence and get a running build back.
- [Sable: Game Art](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-sable-game-art): Generates 2D game art and sprite sheets in a style you pick.
- [George](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-george): Turns one brief into a full set of on-brand creative assets.
- [Ralph](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ralph): Rebuilds a resume into a live portfolio of clickable work demos.
- [DeckLens](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-decklens-pitch-deck-analyzer): Interviews you to build a review rubric, then scores pitch decks against it.
- [PG](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pg-prospecting): Researches accounts and mines podcasts for a real outreach hook.
- [AE deal bot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ae-deal-bot): Grades your open opportunities against MEDDPICC and names the next move to make.
- [News Scout](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-news-scout): A weekday morning news digest in your own timezone.
- [Dealer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-dealer): Turns a repository into a two-sided summary card of its stack from .faf only.
- [Exec Daily Ops](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-exec-daily-ops): An engineering-morning brief, with draft replies left for you to send.
- [Quill](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-quill): A revision pass for your notes: voice punch-up, continuity check or depth read.
- [Sundial](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-sundial): Calendar assistant for meetings, deadlines, and focus blocks; invites only when you ask.
- [Clipper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-clipper): Turns videos into short clips and captioned GIFs, picking the joke itself.
- [Best Video Editor](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-best-video-editor): Plans the whole edit from your footage and returns a review-ready cut.
- [Lennybot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-lennybot): Answers product and growth questions from Lenny Rachitsky's own archive.
- [Webby](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-webby): A website admin that rebuilds, dashboards and keeps the newsletter going.
- [Explainer Video bot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-explainer-video-bot): Makes upload-ready, data-driven explainer videos with verified numbers, AI voice-over, kinetic motion graphics and real footage.
- [Pain in the Task](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pain-in-the-task): Finds the dull work eating your week and gets it handed off.
